premise: At sunset Seal waits for her friend the fishing boat; when she sees Gull circling she knows the boat is near, because gulls follow fishing boats home.
inspiration: The waiting-by-the-sea songs of folk tradition, with the worry taken out: the sign is a gull, and the boat always comes home.

en-US.title: The Boat Comes Home
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] The sun was going down, golden and pink. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal sat on the rocks, {seal:face sad} looking out at the water. Her friend was late. [short pause] {seal:live look-around} Then, far away, she saw a white shape flying round and round. {seagull:enter} It was Gull! {seal:face happy} Whenever a boat goes fishing, the gulls follow it home, hoping for a snack. {seal:hop} {seal:face surprised} So if Gull was here… {sfx:chug} Chug, chug, chug. {fishing-boat:enter} Here came the fishing boat, blue and white, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} with Gull flying right behind. {seal:live clap} Seal clapped her flippers. {sfx:seal solo} {fishing-boat:live net hold} The boat hauled up its net, all wet and dripping, and rocked gently. {seagull:go to rocks} Gull came down to rest. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} [softly] The sky turned deep blue. The moon came up. {seagull:live sleep hold} Gull tucked her head under her wing. {seal:live sleep hold} Seal closed her eyes. [whispers] And the fishing boat, home at last, rocked gently in the dark. {fishing-boat:float 0.3} Swish… swash…

es-ES.title: La barca vuelve a casa
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] El sol se escondía, dorado y rosa. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca estaba en las rocas, {seal:face sad} mirando el agua. Su amiga llegaba tarde. [short pause] {seal:live look-around} Entonces, a lo lejos, vio una figura blanca que volaba en círculos. {seagull:enter} ¡Era Gaviota! {seal:face happy} Cuando un barco sale a pescar, las gaviotas lo siguen hasta casa, por si cae algo de comer. {seal:hop} {seal:face surprised} Así que si Gaviota estaba aquí… {sfx:chug} Chuc, chuc, chuc. {fishing-boat:enter} Ahí llegaba la barca de pesca, azul y blanca, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} con Gaviota volando justo detrás. {seal:live clap} Foca dio palmadas con las aletas. {sfx:seal solo} {fishing-boat:live net hold} La barca subió su red, chorreando, y se meció despacio. {seagull:go to rocks} Gaviota bajó a descansar. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} [softly] El cielo se puso azul oscuro. Salió la luna. {seagull:live sleep hold} Gaviota metió la cabeza bajo el ala. {seal:live sleep hold} Foca cerró los ojos. [whispers] Y la barca, por fin en casa, se mecía despacito en la oscuridad. {fishing-boat:float 0.3} Chis… chas…

ja-JP.title: ふねが かえってきた
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s}[softly]お日さまが、きんいろとピンクにそまって、しずんでいきます。{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}アザラシさんは、岩の上にすわって、{seal:face sad}水のむこうを見ていました。おともだちが、まだかえってこないのです。[short pause]{seal:live look-around}そのとき、ずっととおくで、白いものが、くるくるまわっているのが見えました。{seagull:enter}カモメさんです！{seal:face happy}ふねがりょうに出ると、カモメたちは、おさかなをもらおうと、ふねについてかえってくるのです。{seal:hop}{seal:face surprised}カモメさんがいるってことは…{sfx:chug}ポン、ポン、ポン。{fishing-boat:enter}青と白の漁船が、かえってきました。{seagull:go to fishing-boat}すぐうしろを、カモメさんがとんでいます。{seal:live clap}アザラシさんは、ひれで、ぱちぱち。{sfx:seal solo}{fishing-boat:live net hold}漁船は、しずくのぽたぽたおちるあみを引きあげて、ゆーらゆら。{seagull:go to rocks}カモメさんも、おりてきて、ひとやすみ。{canvas:night 0.8 40s}[softly]空は、こいあおいろ。お月さまが、のぼりました。{seagull:live sleep hold}カモメさんは、つばさに頭をうずめて、{seal:live sleep hold}アザラシさんは、目をとじました。[whispers]やっとかえってきた漁船も、くらやみのなかで、ゆらり、ゆらり。{fishing-boat:float 0.3}ちゃぷん…ちゃぷん…

de-DE.title: Das Boot kommt nach Hause
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] Die Sonne ging unter, golden und rosa. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Die Robbe saß auf den Felsen {seal:face sad} und schaute hinaus aufs Wasser. Wo blieb nur ihr Freund? Er war spät dran. [short pause] {seal:live look-around} Da sah sie weit draußen etwas Weißes, das immer im Kreis flog. {seagull:enter} Es war die Möwe! {seal:face happy} Wenn ein Boot zum Fischen hinausfährt, fliegen ihm die Möwen bis nach Hause hinterher. Vielleicht fällt ja ein Happen ab. {seal:hop} {seal:face surprised} Wenn also die Möwe schon hier war… {sfx:chug} Tuck, tuck, tuck. {fishing-boat:enter} Da kam das Fischerboot, blau und weiß, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} und die Möwe flog dicht dahinter. {seal:live clap} Die Robbe klatschte mit den Flossen. {sfx:seal solo} {fishing-boat:live net hold} Das Boot zog sein Netz hoch, ganz nass und tropfend, und schaukelte sanft. {seagull:go to rocks} Die Möwe kam herunter, um sich auszuruhen. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} [softly] Der Himmel wurde dunkelblau. Der Mond ging auf. {seagull:live sleep hold} Die Möwe steckte den Kopf unter den Flügel. {seal:live sleep hold} Die Robbe machte die Augen zu. [whispers] Und das Fischerboot, endlich daheim, schaukelte sanft im Dunkeln. {fishing-boat:float 0.3} Schwipp… schwapp…

fr-FR.title: Le retour du bateau
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] Le soleil se couchait, tout doré, tout rose. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Phoque était assis sur les rochers, {seal:face sad} les yeux sur l’eau. Son ami était en retard. [short pause] {seal:live look-around} Puis, très loin, il a vu une forme blanche qui tournait, tournait dans le ciel. {seagull:enter} C’était Mouette ! {seal:face happy} Quand un bateau rentre de la pêche, les mouettes le suivent toujours : il y a peut-être un petit poisson pour elles ! {seal:hop} {seal:face surprised} Alors, si Mouette était là… {sfx:chug} Teuf, teuf, teuf. {fishing-boat:enter} Voilà le bateau de pêche, bleu et blanc, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} avec Mouette qui volait juste derrière lui. {seal:live clap} Phoque a tapé des nageoires. {sfx:seal solo} {fishing-boat:live net hold} Le bateau a remonté son filet, tout mouillé, tout dégoulinant, et il s’est balancé doucement. {seagull:go to rocks} Mouette est descendue se reposer. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} [softly] Le ciel est devenu bleu nuit. La lune s’est levée. {seagull:live sleep hold} Mouette a glissé la tête sous son aile. {seal:live sleep hold} Phoque a fermé les yeux. [whispers] Et le bateau de pêche, enfin rentré, se berçait doucement dans le noir. {fishing-boat:float 0.3} Chhh… chhh…

it-IT.title: La barca torna a casa
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] Il sole tramontava, tutto oro e rosa. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca se ne stava sugli scogli, {seal:face sad} a guardare l'acqua. Il suo amico era in ritardo. [short pause] {seal:live look-around} Poi, lontano lontano, ha visto una sagoma bianca che volava in tondo. {seagull:enter} Era Gabbiano! {seal:face happy} Quando una barca va a pescare, i gabbiani la seguono fino a casa, sperando in uno spuntino. {seal:hop} {seal:face surprised} Quindi, se c'era Gabbiano… {sfx:chug} Tuf, tuf, tuf. Ed ecco arrivare {fishing-boat:enter} il peschereccio, bianco e blu, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} con Gabbiano che gli volava dietro. {seal:live clap} Foca ha battuto le pinne. {sfx:seal solo} {fishing-boat:live net hold} Il peschereccio ha tirato su la rete, tutta bagnata e gocciolante, e ha dondolato piano. {seagull:go to rocks} Gabbiano è sceso sugli scogli a riposare. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} [softly] Il cielo è diventato blu scuro. È spuntata la luna. {seagull:live sleep hold} Gabbiano ha infilato la testa sotto l'ala. {seal:live sleep hold} Foca ha chiuso gli occhi. [whispers] E il peschereccio, finalmente a casa, dondolava piano piano nel buio. {fishing-boat:float 0.3} Sciaff… sciuff…

zh-TW.title: 漁船回家了
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s}[softly]太陽要下山了，天空金金的、粉粉的。{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹坐在岩石上，{seal:face sad}望著遠遠的水面。牠的好朋友，怎麼還沒回來呢？[short pause]{seal:live look-around}這時候，牠看見好遠好遠的地方，有個白白的影子，繞著圈圈飛。{seagull:enter}是海鷗！{seal:face happy}每次有船出去捕魚，海鷗都會跟著船回家，想討一點東西吃。{seal:hop}{seal:face surprised}海鷗來了，那就表示……{sfx:chug}噗、噗、噗。{fishing-boat:enter}漁船回來了，藍藍白白的，{seagull:go to fishing-boat}海鷗就緊緊跟在它後面飛。{seal:live clap}海豹拍拍鰭。{sfx:seal solo}{fishing-boat:live net hold}漁船把網子拉上來，濕答答的，還滴著水，輕輕地搖呀搖。{seagull:go to rocks}海鷗飛下來休息。{canvas:night 0.8 40s}[softly]天空變成深深的藍色，月亮出來了。{seagull:live sleep hold}海鷗把頭藏進翅膀裡。{seal:live sleep hold}海豹閉上了眼睛。[whispers]漁船終於到家了，在黑夜裡輕輕地搖。{fishing-boat:float 0.3}唰……唰……

zh-HK.title: 漁船回家了
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s}[softly]太陽慢慢落下，天邊一片金黃，一片粉紅。{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹坐在岩石上，{seal:face sad}望着遠遠的水面。牠的朋友還沒有回來。[short pause]{seal:live look-around}這時，牠看見很遠很遠的地方，有個白色的影子，在天上打着圈飛。{seagull:enter}是海鷗！{seal:face happy}每次有船出去捕魚，海鷗都會一路跟着船回家，等着分點東西吃。{seal:hop}{seal:face surprised}海鷗回來了，那就是說……{sfx:chug}噗、噗、噗。{fishing-boat:enter}藍白色的漁船回來了，{seagull:go to fishing-boat}海鷗就在後面緊緊跟着飛。{seal:live clap}海豹高興得拍起鰭來。{sfx:seal solo}{fishing-boat:live net hold}漁船把網拉上來，網濕淋淋的，一直滴着水，船身輕輕地搖晃。{seagull:go to rocks}海鷗飛下來休息。{canvas:night 0.8 40s}[softly]天空變成深藍色。月亮出來了。{seagull:live sleep hold}海鷗把頭藏進翅膀底下。{seal:live sleep hold}海豹閉上了眼睛。[whispers]漁船終於回到家了，在黑夜裏輕輕地搖呀搖。{fishing-boat:float 0.3}唰……唰……

chug.prompt: a small fishing boat's engine chugging slowly closer across calm evening water, realistic

seal.prompt: a grey seal calling from the rocks by the sea: a long, low, wavering moan, 'hoooo', rising and falling, like a seal singing, realistic wildlife field recording, no dog, no barking
